title: admins.set (platform → server, reliable)
description: Proposed by Ready Up (D5, D13, FLEET.md §7.6). The whole fleet-wide admin list; replaces the previous one. The server ignores a rev lower than the one it has (a replay) and caches the list on disk (readyup-match fleet-admins.json) for offline boots. In fleet mode only this list (plus per-match admins) counts and `ru admins add|remove` are refused. Send it after every welcome and whenever the list changes. No reply beyond the ack.
